notes: BUG-120/D1+D3: profiles freeze the recorded command text. status=candidate means the text was prepared from a real recording but never accepted on a target host; only the development driver (CREO_MECHDOG_PANEL_CANDIDATE) may use it. status=certified means the profile passed the documented target-host acceptance run and normal clients may use it; its certification record must bind this profile digest and ship with the library. creo10-bbl-candidate-2 is certified on Creo 10.0.0.0 (release_numeric=42) as of 2026-11-18; the 'candidate-2' id is historical, the status is what admission reads. Recording originals are preserved under recordings/ and are never rewritten. select_command is the resident command named at runtime; the recorded @PAUSE_FOR_SCREEN_PICK steps are replaced by one invocation per position, because a pause waits for a human click. creo10-bbl-candidate-2 keeps only the T1-B-proven open line (no FocusOut): the recorded FocusOut ran in the T1-A replay only after the dialog existed, and both Creo 10 attempts with it consumed zero positions. select_command must be the whole '~ Command `%MECHDOG_COMMAND%`;' line: the bare placeholder substituted to a bare command name, which Creo 10's macro engine ignored.
